title: Face-with-proof: the four key-frame mocks for Krish's Gate 2, built from the library devices
goal: Krish chose (2 Nov) to finish Thursday 5 Nov through the engine. The face-with-proof format is a draft lock (config/ve/design-lock.json drafts, beats hook, face, proof, close, all four key-frame slots empty), so the engine cannot lay devices over his face until he approves one still per beat and `ve lock freeze` hashes them. Build the four mock compositions; Claude renders them to stills (Codex cannot run Chromium) and puts them to him. Write apps/renderer/src/engine/mocks/face-with-proof.tsx exporting `FWP_MOCKS`: four pure React components (hook, face, proof, close), each drawing one 1080x1920 frame from the existing library devices (cursor_buddy, typing_bubble, logo_card, stamp, scribble) at a fixed frame, plus `apps/renderer/src/engine/mocks/face-with-proof.test.ts` that renders each to static markup and checks the rules below. No new device, no per-piece code, nothing under docs/plans. The look (his references DeZuQ7-lATg and DeypYeWN5hL; the signed storyboard docs/plans/2026-11-02-week/thu-storyboard.md, read only): a split frame. The top 1000 px is a light stage (tokens.cream) where the proof device plays, scaled up to fill it; the camera plate sits below in the face band (use the my-test-19s fixture recording's poster frame as an , never redrawn), his eyes never covered; one caption line in the lock's caption zone (x 72, y 1180, w 900, h 320) in the house caption style; the brand dress (logo top left, series tag top right). - hook: cursor_buddy (at least 420 px tall) proud, a notification typing_bubble above it: 'Done! Booked the team offsite in Ibiza'. Caption 'Proactive AI is coming'. - face: his face full frame (no stage), one kinetic label from the headline device or a caption only. Caption 'It doesn't spend my money'. - proof: logo_card with Meta, Amazon, Google over xAI, Anthropic (official marks from config/logo-registry.json), each mark at least 140 px. Caption 'Amazon for your groceries'. - close: two slabs NO SPENDING / NO SENDING (stamp device scaled so its words are at least 72 px; ink on mint, never coral fill), cursor_buddy sulking beside them. Caption 'no spending, no sending'. Rules: TEMPLATE.md anti-patterns (no coral as a status or fill, no mint type on cream, nothing under 30 px, no tag or provenance label); colours only from tokens; type roles from HOUSE_FONTS; composition fill at least 80% outside the caption zone; nothing key beyond x 960 or y 1640.
contract: Device rules: apps/renderer/src/engine/devices/CONTRACT.md. Reuse devices as they are; scale with a wrapper transform only. Pure functions of props, no Math.random, no wall clock.
